svg.title: Mario Teaches Typing, manually traced title reconstruction
svg.desc: Editable paths aligned to the supplied 1540 by 968 title reference at one-half scale. No embedded reference pixels. Original legal text, TM and creator overlay omitted. Hidden lower desk and shoe are reconstructed.
